scope: Resolve three earlier requested source identities and inspect two small native configs plus selected commander declarations/helpers; not complete AI Zeus review or source implementation.

sources.name: isky's A.I Skill Tweaks
sources.identity: Installed meta.cpp publishedid2905259701 and matching name; isky author in decoded binary config.
sources.scopeRead: Entire decoded config. Original PBO has only brain/config.bin; effective addon loading not observed.
findings: Native brain countermeasure, suppression and aiming-error component changes, not per-unit setSkill scripts.

CfgWeapons, CfgAmmo, CfgSurfaces and CfgVehicles are nested under CfgBrains in the decoded binary. They do not occupy the root paths CBE uses; do not award functioning weapon, steering or ammo parity from those declarations. Exact engine loading remains unverified.
Native brain values overlap CBE optional suppression/turret policies with different tuning; overlapping configs cannot be treated as additive improvements.
Launcher properties include player dispersion/recoil/sound and ammunition ballistics/effects; CUP/RHS declarations are compatibility scope, not a blanket tactical implementation requirement.
sources.next: Evaluate native countermeasure/suppression/aiming intent against current engine declarations and CBE settings without overwriting mission skill policy; do not transplant nested classes or claim inactive declarations work.

sources.name: AI Zeus - Autonomous Battlefield Commander
sources.identity: Installed mod.cpp and meta.cpp publishedid3623550024; config declares version1.12.0.
sources.scopeRead: Addon identity, declared CBA/functions/modules dependencies, function-area inventory, selected skill application and waypoint-clear helpers. Whole strategic implementation NOT reviewed.
findings: Scope includes strategic/fog-of-war/doctrine/combined-arms/module work beyond recent tactical guards. Declared function folders are an evaluation queue, not delivered capabilities.

Selected skill entry can choose all living controlled-side non-blacklisted units and delegates randomized values to setSkillsLocal. Do not adopt broad skill rewrites over mission/custom AI policies. Caller/service authority still needs full trace.

Selected waypoint helper clears all native waypoints, locally for owner<=2 or through BIS_fnc_call on a remote owner. Caller authority not traced; do not copy wholesale route deletion into CBE exact-generation cleanup.
sources.next: Read startup, controlled-group admission, deterministic strategic decision/execution and cancellation chains; then evaluate the complete relevant modules. LLM/provider paths are not assumed required or safe merely because declared.

sources.name: Drongo's Grenade Tweaks Lite
sources.identity: Matching installed content directory and meta name plus root patch name/author; meta publishedid0 is not independent ID confirmation.
sources.scopeRead: Entire root and bundled LAMBS plaintext variants; root compiled config independently decoded to root-effective.json and key values inspected.
findings: AI ThrowMuzzle probability1.015, minimum range20, rate3/dispersion2/distance60; UGL Single probability1.05, minimum50, rate4/dispersion1/distance400 and AI spread1.4/2. These are observed source values, not accepted CBE balance.

Ammo cost/usage preference accompanies GrenadeBase indirectHitRange10,40mmHE9 and20mmHE6. These damage properties are shared gameplay changes, not AI-only behaviour; do not import them as AI enhancements.

Bundled LAMBS alternative has equivalent policy with different patch dependencies, including Drongos_Grenade_Tweaks rather than root LITE patch. No separate alternative PBO found; automatic activation not proven. CBE must remain standalone, without a LAMBS dependency.
sources.next: Evaluate selected native AI grenade choice/cadence against CBE explicit grenade control and ammunition/friendly safety. That native choice layer is not implemented by merely having a scripted throw/evasion function.

productionBoundary: No product behaviour changed and no percentage/source parity awarded. Raw extractions and their manifest remain ignored/private. No upstream scripts/assets shipped; licensing remains unverified before code reuse.
validation: Source PBO hashes reverified and private hashes recorded; tracked reference boundary checked. Reuse last1497/413SQF/11PBO offline candidate with dirty unsigned provenance; no unchanged full build repeated. Audits PAUSED.
